display_name: Stylized fossil thallus fragment: Bosworthia ribbon-branch thallus
generic_fallback_name: Preserved algal thallus teaching fragment inspired by bosworthia
purpose: Children’s marine-scene variety and/or honestly labeled specimen teaching display; natural refined original low-poly form.

subject.pose: Shallow preserved fragment presentation; no inferred complete living stance.

claim_scope: Preserved-organ/thallus structural-fragment teaching concept only; no complete mother organism or rooted marine vegetation claim.

distinctness.en: Broad ribbon branches with limited terminal subdivision differ from Waputikia's thick axis and fine terminal bushes.
distinctness.zh: 宽带枝及有限末级分叉区别于Waputikia粗主轴和细末端枝丛。

modeling_brief.en: Model flattened flexible ribbons in a shallow fossil relief; preserve the documented fork arrangement instead of a shrub analogy.
modeling_brief.zh: 以浅化石浮雕构建扁柔带枝，保留记录的分叉方式，不套用灌木。

shape_plan_zh: 严格限原清单preserved thallus specimen：浅浮雕/浅厚度的柔带分叉片段，不套用灌木，不添加未知母体、完整固着器、根系或未经依据的整株立体冠；可不带岩板，但仍标为结构片段教学展示。
coverage_justification: Approved practical profile: eight fixed useful views, no production turntable; add targeted views only for an actual concern.

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

style: Natural refined low-poly, credible proportions and soft connections; restrained child-friendly cartooning, no mechanical assembly or unnecessary large maps.
artistic_choices: Nominal dimensions, colors and limited thickness/pose are artistic choices, not fossil measurement.
Never enlarge a source scope from fragment to whole organism or freshwater to marine merely for scene filler.

reference_policy.scope: Child-friendly static stylized-inspired environment prop; no strict scientific reconstruction.
reference_policy.minimum_reference: Use a reliable named museum/specimen/institution or primary reference supporting recognizable basic form; existing ledger entries are retrieval leads with inherited access notes, not a new verification by this planning task. Group-only overview cannot prove a genus-specific diagnostic feature. No mandatory species/specimen matching beyond the basic form actually claimed.
reference_policy.reference_rights: Consulting facts does not require licensing a copied asset. References are consulted-only, with source URLs and actual access status retained. No reference media/scan/mesh is incorporated. If incorporating third-party media, record actual rights/license/permission first; the string consulted-only is not a third-party license grant. Prefer original geometry/maps and avoid this dependency.
reference_policy.continue_rule: Once reliable basic form and original/authorized inputs are established, proceed after the parent CI/claim gate. Do not repeatedly research or repair because color, restored soft tissue, pose, dimensions, plate/feather counts or fine reconstruction are uncertain. Label artistic choices.
reference_policy.block_only: A real basic identity contradiction, no reliable support for the named form actually claimed, unlicensed incorporated material, visibly broken proportion/connection at intended view, or failed required technical/delivery checks remains actionable. Narrow unsupported claims to the descriptive inspired-by fallback; do not invent sources or a factual PASS.
reference_policy.repair_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair as the inherited practical profile specifies; persistent required defects return to parent for scope/hold decision rather than an open-ended reconstruction campaign.

review_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair; persistent genuine required defect goes to parent. Uncertain fine reconstruction is advisory, not repeat-work fuel.
publication_authority: QA-passed batches authorized to push/merge without per-model approval, exclusively parent-coordinated release; this planning task cannot release or dispatch.

criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates/reimports; finite geometry, units/origin and measured separate budgets; warnings dispositioned.
All eight fixed QA views and actual-GLB runtime evidence; readable distinct silhouette, credible proportions, soft natural connections at normal/near viewing scale. Counts do not certify beauty.

严格限原清单preserved thallus specimen：浅浮雕/浅厚度的柔带分叉片段，不套用灌木，不添加未知母体、完整固着器、根系或未经依据的整株立体冠；可不带岩板，但仍标为结构片段教学展示。 Preserve original reference scope, uncertainty and representation label. No extra microscopic or precise life-reconstruction obligations.

Editable Blend, standalone GLB, deterministic generator/config and dependency hashes, bilingual metadata/scope/provenance/attribution, original small maps if used, transparent cover, eight fixed views and actual-GLB runtime evidence.
Exact GLB parsed by pinned target loader; record bounds/material/texture/errors.
Declared functional graphics runtime; identify software/hardware honestly, no unsupported physical-device performance claim.
Neutral multiple-copy teaching-prop benchmark with actual instance/work counts; no actual museum integration or cross-era habitat claim.
